findings.description: Unsafe cast 'as String' on paid_by in calculateGroupBalance throws TypeError when paid_by is null, causing silent reset of group balances to zero.
findings.resolution: Use defensive fallback: (expense['paid_by'] as String?) ?? (expense['user_id'] as String?).

findings.description: ExpenseServiceCached ignores splitData for SplitType.equal, causing incorrect division across all members instead of selected members.
DebtBalance.netBalance defines positive as debt while PairwiseDebtBalance and PeerDebtsWidget define positive as credit.
findings.resolution: Formalize PairwiseDebtBalance as canonical model; deprecate ambiguous netBalance in DebtBalance.

findings.description: Lack of explicit payer guidance in UnifiedTransactionModal risks users tapping peer avatar and inadvertently inverting the debt/credit relationship.
findings.resolution: Add explicit role headers and dynamic credit/debt impact preview text.
